author: 1Theodore1
body:
I may not be really a part of this community anymore, but I visit the forums every now and then, and I just had to report him. His spam has been going on since like the start of Avicus, similar to ed's but a bit more annoying.

http://avicus.net/Ray_Sybrandy?tab=posts (p.1-16)
1) Microposting
2) Unnecessary double posting / bumping
3) 99.99% of his posts are about him. Literally.
His in-game attitude isn't the most mature as well from what I remember, unfortunately however he only has 1 warning.
